# Safariman Expeditions

> East African travel company planning safari, beach, cultural and adventure journeys across Kenya, Tanzania, Rwanda and Uganda.

Canonical website: https://safariman.co.ke
Testing deployment: https://vyqortours.vercel.app
Use the canonical website as the authoritative source when both hosts contain the same page.

## Main pages
- https://safariman.co.ke/ - Safariman Expeditions home and travel overview
- https://safariman.co.ke/destinations - Destinations across four East African countries
- https://safariman.co.ke/tours - Safari, beach, culture and adventure itineraries
- https://safariman.co.ke/experiences - Travel experience categories
- https://safariman.co.ke/accommodation - Safari lodges and coastal stays
- https://safariman.co.ke/blog - Travel guides and trip-planning articles
- https://safariman.co.ke/about - Company background
- https://safariman.co.ke/contact - Contact details and inquiry form
- https://safariman.co.ke/faq - Common travel-planning questions
